newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable in dull late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable in dull late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in slow late trading on Friday despite a sudden tightening in the money market, dealers said.
They said volume was thin in the spot market, with some surprises seen in the money market after the overnight rate jumped to 18.0 percent from 10.0 percent.
"I don't know what happened. I got some money at 10.0 percent at 0700 GMT. But suddenly state banks were seen coming to the market and call rates jumped," one local dealer said.
She said it might be due to under-estimation of weekly tax payments due Friday as people were expecting ample liquidity following a flush market late on Thursday.
One Japanese bank dealer said the underlying tone for the rupiah remained cautious, with a further gradual decline expected due to the ongoing election campaign lasting till May 23.
"I prefer to go long on dollars especially over the weekend. Who knows what may happen during the weekend," he said.
Spot rupiah was last at 2,431.0/32.0 at 0920 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,434.5/35.5.
Spot rupiah fell to a low of 2,434.50 from an opening of 2,434.5/35.5 before rebounding on offshore buying.
Tomorrow and today closed at 2,430.60/31.60 and 2,432.50/32.75, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.8/0.9 and tom/next at 0.38/0.40.
Dealers said swap rates were barely changed.
One-month swaps were at 12.0/12.6, two at 24.75/25.50, three at 36.5/37.5 and six at 74.5/75.5 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,409/2,457 on Friday.
